purpose: Identify evidence-backed MSC compiler profiles for the named Win16 game-C families in _TEXT; record byte-exact profile evidence, controlled instruction probes, assignments, recompiled drafts, and admissions.

original_compiler.generation: Microsoft C/C++ 7.00 optimizing backend for sampled game code
original_compiler.exact_driver_and_pass_binaries: POSSIBLE: pinned 7.00 distribution reproduces discriminating probes; historical executable alone does not authenticate original CL/C1/C2 hashes
original_compiler.different_game_compilers: POSSIBLE but not required by tested probes; CRT generation is independently older

baseline.description: Locked conservative profile: /Oe register allocation, /Ol loop optimisation, /Ow aliasing across calls. Every admitted msc700 source was proven under it.

og.description: Baseline plus /Og global common-subexpression elimination and register write-through before calls. Discriminated by parked code-shape bodies; refuted for the win_SetColorFromObj object.

ogi.description: og plus /Oi intrinsic generation (inline memset/memcpy/strlen/strcat forms). Requires string-intrinsic fingerprints in the target.

ga.description: Baseline plus /GA Windows application prologue optimisation. Requires exported-prologue evidence; invariant on the admitted corpus.

og-ga.description: og plus /GA. Requires both kinds of evidence.

initial_nbcheck_best_loop_probe_snapshot.scope: Bounded profile probe of one preserved candidate: evidence for a context assignment, never recovery credit or a queue change

catalog_summary.summary: 362 of 363 admitted msc700 sources compile to identical CODE bytes under baseline, og and ogi; all 363 are identical under ga. The admitted corpus therefore cannot identify the historical switches; only the discriminating members do.

assignments.reason: The topology Ma:10 semantic cluster is one contiguous memory-helper family. MaLock reaches CONFIRMED_MEMBER only under /Og, minimal over baseline; admitted Ma helpers are /Og-invariant in the optimizer-profile corpus.

The NetBIOS wrapper family is the topology Nb:13 cluster plus _CopyName. The readable memset form reaches STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_MEMBER only under /Oegilw; /Oi is the minimal added switch and emits the target mov cx,0x40; rep stosb. The best byte-loop draft does not discriminate.

unassigned_families.reason: No catalogued profile improves the preserved _FlipWord candidate; no tested MSC 7 switch set or MSC 6.00A baseline produced XCHG AH,AL for arithmetic, union-byte, or byte-pointer swap probes.
The near-exact _GtRegisterClass draft has no catalogued-profile discriminator; no family profile assignment was justified.
The preserved draft remains 372/436 aligned opcodes; no near-exact profile probe supports a family assignment.
